scans.answer_at_t_val: The center is a = pi and the blue target curve is f(x) = cos(x). Thus c_0 = f(pi) = -1, c_1 = f'(pi) = -sin(pi) = 0, and c_2 = f''(pi)/2! = -cos(pi)/2 = 1/2. The quadratic is P_2(x) = -1 + (1/2)(x-pi)^2.
